show.name: La primera vez
show.summary: A mysterious teen girl arrives at an all-boys school in 1970s Colombia, breaking stereotypes, rules... and a few hearts.

episodes.name: La primera mujer
episodes.summary: After debuting his first novel, Camilo is shaken when his friends turn against him. Luisa and Arbeláez's decision opens the door to 364.

episodes.name: Ideario feminista
episodes.summary: Eva's visit to the Dominican Republic's embassy is unexpectedly interrupted. Camilo and the group mobilize to stop a tragedy from occurring.

episodes.name: Vainas y otros poemas
episodes.summary: Eva and Camilo take a big step in their relationship. Vandalia's activities threaten the group's safety. Rosario tries to start a school for Janet.

episodes.name: La señorita Julia
episodes.summary: A move highlights the differences between Eva and Camilo's lives. Arbeláez defends Janet, and a visitor throws a wrench in Ana and José's relationship.

episodes.name: México y el viaje al país de los Tarahumaras
episodes.summary: Money troubles push Camilo and Eva over the edge. Janet makes a proposal to Rosario and José regarding her future. Lucy joins the tenants of 364.

episodes.name: El teatro y su doble
episodes.summary: A trip to Cauca for a special ceremony yields breakthroughs for Eva and Pabón. José helps Camilo find a legendary wrestler.

episodes.name: Crítica de la economía política del signo
episodes.summary: Eva's new job has unforeseen challenges. A series of massive life changes put Camilo and Eva under intense pressure. A familiar face returns.

episodes.name: Delta de Venus
episodes.summary: Eva pursues a new career. A chat with Estela inspires Lucy to step out of her comfort zone. A critique of Camilo's novel leads him to new pursuits.

episodes.name: Seis personajes en busca de un autor
episodes.summary: Eva's and Camilo's careers take off, as Pabón falls in love. A talk with Castro leaves Salcedo suspicious as relationships implode.

episodes.name: La Biblia
episodes.summary: Salcedo's addiction catches up to him, and an invitation from José changes his life. The AIDS epidemic shakes Pabón. Eva's work trip unbalances Camilo.

episodes.name: Sobre la educación
episodes.summary: Three years later, Eva returns to Colombia — but she isn't alone. Camilo lashes out. Janet makes a new friend, much to José's consternation.

episodes.name: El atravesado
episodes.summary: The group makes a movie, but an M-19 incident changes the course of their lives. Oswald throws José a curveball, and Ana's proposal takes off.
